CARE IS IN
THE DETAILS.

From the first box to the last flight of stairs, good preparation makes a difference. A useful move brief helps a removal company assess the job properly.

  • Confirm insurance limits and exclusions
  • Check who handles specialist items
  • Agree access, parking and arrival windows
  • Get the full price and terms in writing
